title: Make AI write exactly like YOU

segments.say: Everyone can tell when AI wrote your post.
Day two. Make AI write exactly like you.
segments.show: Day 02. Make AI write exactly like you.

segments.say: Most people type, write a LinkedIn post... and get: thrilled to embark on this journey.
Fix it in three steps. Feed: paste three things you actually wrote. Extract: ask it to turn your tone and favorite words into a style guide. Apply: use that guide for every draft.
